purpose: Test whether prediction-only shape/response features improve the repair-damage balance beyond area-only calibration.

data.selection: random.Random(20260915).shuffle(sorted images by id), first 2000, without inspecting outcomes
data.val: existing 4500 COCO val2017 confirmation images, no fitting or model selection there; previously explored

calibration_action: Apply fixed tau=.75/(1+(A/2304)^2) only when predicted continuous IoU gain >0; otherwise retain original mask. Newly empty calibration outputs also retain original baseline mask. Candidate scores, boxes and counts unchanged.

response: fraction of foreground removed by fixed calibration

training.target: calibrated minus baseline mask IoU for all baseline matched ordinary GT; delta0 for newly emptied masks, matching deployed action
training.match: same existing confidence-first same-class BoxIoU>=.5 one-to-one slots
training.GT_use: targets only, no GT input features; fit split only

global_control.selection: COCO Mask AP on 500 train2017 selection images; ties lower threshold

primary_metrics: COCO Mask AP, AP75, size AP
fixed-slot R75 repair/damage with all ordinary GT denominator
decision: Report all three learned gates on selection set; freeze them and evaluate on existing val bank. No hyperparameter or rule changes based on val. Do not call successful unless normal AP and repair/damage jointly support improvement over fixed smooth and learned area.
limitations: train images were seen by pretrained backbone
matched-only fitting may not generalize to unmatched predictions
small calibration subset; class and size confounding addressed only partly by area comparator
new risk predictor is a method candidate, not a new causal claim
